comment: Independent trap.c witness for drown() -> water_damage_chain() -> water_damage() -> erode_obj() on a blessed item: the debug Priest, whose starting mace is blessed, wishes a pool under himself (objnam.c wizterrainwish()), steps east, and steps back with the m prefix so that hack.c swim_move_danger() lets him in. drown() rusts the mace after erode_obj() draws rnl(4) at trap.c:257, and he crawls out. The seed, date and keys were chosen for this case.
